import tempfile, os
from cfnlint.decode import cfn_yaml
from cfnlint.rules import RulesCollection
from cfnlint.rules.resources.properties.Properties import Properties
from cfnlint.runner import Runner
TMPL_A = 'AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"\nResources:\n  Custom:\n    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource\n    Properties:\n      ServiceToken: arn.example\n  Helper:\n    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function\n    Properties:\n      Handler: helper.lambda_handler\n      Role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/role-name-with-path\n      Code: !GetAtt Custom.Code\n'
TMPL_B = 'AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"\nResources:\n  MyBucket:\n    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket\n  Helper:\n    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function\n    Properties:\n      Handler: helper.lambda_handler\n      Role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/role-name-with-path\n      Code: !GetAtt MyBucket.Arn\n'
def run_props(text):
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.yaml')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
            f.write(text)
        template = cfn_yaml.load(path)
        col = RulesCollection()
        col.register(Properties())
        r = Runner(col, path, template, ['us-east-1'], [])
        r.transform()
        return [str(m) for m in r.run()]
    finally:
        os.unlink(path)
ma = run_props(TMPL_A)
mb = run_props(TMPL_B)
print('getatt_sequence', [len(ma), len(mb)])
print('getatt_b_detail', mb[:1])
assert len(ma) == 0, ma
assert len(mb) == 1 and 'custom resource' in mb[0], mb
